ns2:section.sectionText: Arts Experiences for Incarcerated Youth. In this course students design and facilitate a weekly arts (music, visual art, dance, drama) experience for youth detained at the Champaign County Detention Center. Course is intended for music education majors, art education majors, theatre majors, dance majors, and community arts minors, but all majors are welcome to enroll. Weekly class MEETS AND IS HELD AT THE DETENTION CENTER.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
